wedding-decor.title: Wedding Décor
wedding-decor.description: Our wedding décor philosophy begins with your story. Whether you dream of opulent floral canopies dripping with roses, minimalist ivory elegance, or a Rajasthani-inspired riot of colour, our décor team translates your vision into a living, breathing environment. We handle everything — from entrance arches and mandap design to centrepieces, lighting, drapery, and the final finishing touches that make a venue unmistakably yours.
features: Full venue décor concept and mood boarding
Floral design — fresh, dried, and silk arrangements
Lighting design: ambient, fairy lights, chandeliers

photography.title: Photography & Film
photography.description: Your wedding day unfolds in a series of irreplaceable moments — the catch of breath as the doors open, the laughter-soaked chaos of the baraat, the stillness of a vow exchanged. Our photography and cinematography partners are masters of capturing what words cannot. From editorial-style couple portraits to emotional documentary coverage, every frame is composed with artistic intention and technical excellence.

catering.title: Catering & Cuisine
catering.description: Food is at the heart of every great Indian celebration — a reflection of family, region, and generosity. Our catering partners include India\'s finest caterers across pan-Indian, Mughlai, South Indian, Continental, and fusion cuisine, as well as specialist chefs for dietary requirements. We design menus that balance tradition with innovation, presentation with abundance, and flavour with flair.
features: Bespoke menu design for each event
Live cooking stations (chaat, kebab, pasta, dessert)
Jain, vegan, gluten-free, and allergy-aware menus

mehndi.title: Mehndi & Beauty
mehndi.description: The Mehndi ceremony is one of the most intimate and joyful rituals of the Indian wedding. Our curated roster of mehndi artists ranges from masters of traditional Rajasthani and Mughal patterns to contemporary artists who blend cultural motifs with fine-line minimalism. We also coordinate all bridal and bridesmaid beauty services — makeup artists, hairstylists, and nail artists — ensuring every member of your bridal party feels their most radiant.
features: Bridal mehndi — both hands and feet
Hidden name motif for the groom to find
Bridal makeup — traditional and HD airbrush

entertainment.title: Entertainment
entertainment.description: A great wedding has a rhythm — the DJ who reads the dance floor, the live band that makes aunties forget their age, the surprise act that no one saw coming. WAH Momentz curates premium entertainment — from Bollywood DJs and live classical ensembles to celebrity performers, dhol players, fireworks, laser shows, and custom choreography — to create a celebration that your guests will talk about for years.
features: Live wedding bands — Sufi, jazz, folk, fusion

venue-management.title: Venue Management
venue-management.description: The right venue sets the entire tone. Whether you envision a grand heritage haveli in Rajasthan, a lush garden in the Nilgiris, a ballroom in a five-star city hotel, or a beachside celebration in Goa, our venue specialists have the relationships and expertise to find and secure the ideal space. We also provide complete venue operations management — staffing, logistics, permits, and day-of coordination — so everything runs seamlessly.
features: Venue search and shortlisting across India
Venue layout planning and flow design

honeymoon.title: Honeymoon Planning
honeymoon.description: Your honeymoon is the first chapter of your married life — and it deserves to be extraordinary. Our honeymoon planning service designs personalised itineraries for couples who want their post-wedding escape to be as thoughtfully curated as their wedding. From Maldivian overwater villas and European château stays to backpacker-chic Bali and safari adventures in Kenya, we handle every booking, transfer, and surprise so you can simply be present with each other.

anniversary.title: Anniversary Celebrations
anniversary.description: Every anniversary is a milestone worth marking — whether it\'s your first year together or your twenty-fifth. WAH Momentz designs anniversary celebrations that reflect how your relationship has evolved: intimate candlelit dinners in extraordinary settings, surprise birthday and anniversary parties, and grand vow renewal ceremonies with all the people who matter most. We take care of every detail so you can be fully present.

bachelorette.title: Bachelorette Party
bachelorette.description: The bachelorette is the bride\'s night to be celebrated in exactly the way she dreams — whether that means a luxurious spa day with her closest girlfriends, a cocktail-filled evening in a rooftop suite, a weekend getaway to Goa, or a private dinner with dancing and personalised surprises. WAH Momentz designs bachelorette experiences that feel personal, playful, and completely hers.
features: Venue sourcing — suites, rooftops, beach clubs, spas
Activity curation — spa, cooking class, wine tasting, dance workshop
Personalised gift bags and party favours

invitations.title: Invitation Design
invitations.description: Your wedding invitation is the first experience your guests have of your celebration — a preview of the beauty and thoughtfulness to come. Our invitation design service creates bespoke stationery suites that reflect your personal aesthetic, from ultra-luxurious boxed invitations with wax seals and hand-tied ribbons to elegant minimalist cards with foil letterpress typography. We handle design, production, and dispatch.

fashion-shows.title: Fashion Shows
fashion-shows.description: WAH Momentz produces fashion shows and trousseau events for designer brands, couture houses, jewellery brands, and private clients. Whether you\'re launching a bridal collection, hosting a trousseau preview for family, or producing a gala fashion evening at your wedding celebration, our production team brings the runway to life with professional staging, lighting, choreography, and model coordination.
features: Brand activation and social media integration

award-nights.title: Award Nights & Galas
award-nights.description: An award night is more than a ceremony — it\'s a moment of recognition, celebration, and brand prestige. WAH Momentz produces award nights and gala dinners that leave recipients and guests genuinely moved. From intimate industry awards with 50 guests to grand national galas for 500+, we handle every element — concept, staging, entertainment, production, and the seamless execution that makes your event a landmark occasion.

conference.title: Conferences & Summits
conference.description: A well-executed conference or summit is a powerful platform — for ideas, for networking, and for your brand. WAH Momentz manages corporate conferences, leadership summits, industry panels, product launch events, and multi-day conventions with the same attention to detail and quality standards we bring to every event. From intimate 30-person offsites to 1,000-delegate conventions, we plan and execute with precision.

corporate-events.title: Corporate Events
corporate-events.description: Corporate events are a powerful expression of brand identity and team culture. WAH Momentz brings the same meticulous attention to detail and creative excellence we apply to weddings to conferences, product launches, dealer meets, award nights, and team celebrations. We understand that a successful corporate event delivers measurable results — engagement, brand recall, and inspiration — alongside a seamless experience.
